text:
Cause found and verified against ESPN just now: the Live tab asked ESPN's plain college-football scoreboard, which lists only ~16 featured games. FBS (Pitt@BC, Kansas@KSU, Rutgers@MD) and FCS (Brown@Princeton, Duquesne, Hampton) games are on the group boards (groups=80 gives 62 games, groups=81 gives 59). Fixed in the live tab, the paper lab and the feed race: NCAAF now reads both groups, NCAAB Division I; ships in the next release. (Grading already used groups=80; FCS grading is a smaller gap I'll also close.)

Your APIs with live scores, from their docs (not yet seen on live keys here): Pinnodds has score and clock on the socket (best for live betting, app-only). SportsGameOdds Pro has team scores, periods and status per event (polled, no socket). OddsPapi v5 has per-period scores and status. Unabated (free) has team scores and a live status (15 s delayed). PropLine has scores. Kalshi has play-by-play per game. BoltOdds Pro does NOT have scores. Next: feed SGO/OddsPapi/Unabated scores to the live lane as a fallback when ESPN has no match.
